initialObservation.source: Uncommitted title/help handler read earlier in this chat before importRequest guards were added
initialObservation.note: The first observation was not persisted with a source hash. This report is an honest rerun of the same underlying await race from an immutable Git baseline, rather than assigning a later hash to the earlier observation.

method: Exact original file onchange handler and applyLoadedRuling extracted from git show, evaluated in isolated memory with DOM/presentation stubs. Real hunt-engine create/export/import generate and validate the save. An intervening public-state adoption and autosave are modeled while File.text remains pending. This is not a native browser, real file-picker, gameplay, or disk/localStorage run.

inputs.origin: Generated in memory through actual E.create and E.exportSave, not a user save or hand-built raw state

sequence: Start the original onchange handler for selected file A; keep its File.text promise unresolved.
Adopt valid newer hunt B into the same controller-state variable and autosave B in the isolated map.
Resolve A's pending read with its valid engine-exported save text.
Await original handler completion and import the isolated saved output through E.importSave.

result.confirmed: Selected older file A overwrote newer hunt B and then autosaved A.

limitation: This proves the controller's stale asynchronous adoption without a DOM transaction token. It does not measure how often real file I/O overlaps an actual user switch, nor claim that a user save was lost in native QA.
